rows.label: tlk44510182_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I imagine this must be intriguing
to you travelers. Ether from the
Divine Beast flows inside here.

rows.label: tlk44510182_01_msg0002
rows.name:
You can feel the energy just by
standing here, see? Isn't it warm?

rows.label: tlk44510182_01_msg0003
rows.name:
To the Divine Beast that grants us
its blessings...

rows.label: tlk44510182_01_msg0004
rows.name:
And to Adel-sama, who brought peace
to our ancestors. I offer prayers to
them every day.
